name: Advanced Form
description: Declutters node edit forms by hiding configured fields with CSS, revealable via a client-side toggle (a UI convenience, NOT access control).
project_description: Advanced Form is a lightweight UI tweak that slims down cluttered Drupal node edit forms. An administrator configures a set of CSS-selector rules; the module injects a generated stylesheet into node forms that hides the matching elements with `display: none`, and a small client-side toggle button lets editors reveal the full form on demand. Rules can be made context-sensitive: selecting a taxonomy term (or any options-select value) in the form adds a `selected-<label>` body class so rules can hide or show fields depending on what is chosen. This keeps day-to-day editing simple for trusted content editors without stripping access or adding permission layers. The hiding is purely cosmetic (CSS/JS on the client) and is explicitly not a security control — the full form is still present and submittable. The 2.0.x rewrite targets node forms only via hook_form_node_form_alter().
